name: LiveGalGame
tagline: An amazing app that lets you chat with girls like a GalGame.
blurb: Some galgame players reported that subtitles and dialogue boxes didn't pop up when talking to female characters.
description:
Some galgame players reported that subtitles and dialogue boxes didn't pop up when talking to female characters. This app was developed to address this issue.

As a prank app, it currently doesn't integrate AI and can run offline.

Currently, a dialogue box pops up when asking a question; more fun features can be added later.
